interactions.conditions: Assert Board P JOUT1: pins 1/2 VBUS_OUT, 3 ATT, 4 PDOK, 5/6 GND. Assert Board L J2: pins 1/2 VBUS_L, 3 ATT, 4 PDOK, 5/6 GND. Verify pin-1 orientation on both layouts before cable definition

With power absent, inspect mating latch/key, tug-test every crimp, continuity-test all six conductors end-to-end, verify no adjacent shorts and duplicate power/ground conductors, then current-limit first power and check connector/wire temperature under maximum intended load
